characters.name: エルナ
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished full-body playable character concept illustration for a fantasy typing battle game, single character on a simple luminous background.
Reference image 1 is ONLY a rendering, palette, fantasy-world and lighting reference. It is not an edit target. Match its exquisitely detailed painterly anime-game fantasy illustration, soft atmospheric illumination, elegant ivory/gold/celestial-blue materials and delicate Gothic ornament. Translate the same illustration quality into a clearly readable anime fantasy protagonist, with a carefully drawn face and elegant expressive eyes. Original character design.
World: two angel siblings leave heaven against their elders' wishes, believing they can correct humanity, then discover morally complicated human lives. This is their idealistic appearance before the journey.
Shared family design language: pale ash-blond hair with subtle silver highlights, clear sky-blue eyes, one pair of white feathered wings, one thin floating golden circular halo, a small gold feather-shaped clasp, ivory cloth and gold piping accented with blue. Travel-ready clothing, practical boots, graceful youthful proportions, subtle personality through posture. Both look like young adults, not children or chibi.
Composition: full body from halo to boot soles with generous margins, all hands, wings and weapon fully visible. ONE main character only, slight three-quarter facing the viewer, confident readable silhouette suitable for a character-selection screen. Request a VERTICAL 2:3 portrait canvas, not the landscape aspect ratio of the reference. Background is a very pale blue/ivory gradient with soft distant cloud atmosphere and a subtle ground shadow, no detailed buildings or scenery. Character is sharp and detailed, background quiet.
Avoid: additional characters, collages, grids, multiple views, text, names, labels, logos, UI, watermarks, cropped wing tips or feet, enormous battle armor, excessive jewelry, modern streetwear, photorealism, heavy black outlines, plastic 3D rendering, skimpy costumes or sexualized posing.
Character: ELNA, the older sister, a young adult angel woman in her early twenties. Long smooth pale ash-blond hair, one neat side braid, refined and kind but serious expression, steady sky-blue gaze, no smugness. Tall graceful silhouette, shoulders composed, standing with quiet certainty.
Costume: an elegant tailored ivory long travel coat with deep sapphire blue lining, gold piping and subtle architectural embroidery at cuffs and hem. Modest fitted high-collar blue inner tunic, layered knee-length navy underskirt, ivory leggings and practical dark-blue knee-high boots, white gloves, a small fitted sapphire shoulder cape. Cloth layers should move softly rather than appear stiff.
Wings: long gracefully tapered white feather wings, held partly open behind her in a tall swept silhouette, recognizable as larger than her brother's wings.
Weapon: a slim ivory-and-gold writing staff that can become a spear, approximately her height, with a clearly recognizable golden quill-nib-shaped point and a small sapphire inset. Hold it upright at her side in one relaxed gloved hand, fully in frame. Other hand naturally rests lightly near the gold feather clasp.
Personality: believes that restoring order will save people, diligent and responsible, protects her brother. A calm poised heroine with a touch of gentleness in the eyes. Predominant sapphire blue and ivory with restrained gold. Soft golden rim light, beautiful feather detailing.

Character: TOWA, the younger brother, a young adult angel man in his late teens. Short tousled pale ash-blond hair with silver highlights, clearly male youthful face, bright sky-blue eyes, an open warm optimistic smile. Lean agile build, slightly shorter-looking proportions than his older sister; not muscular or babyish. A lightly forward-leaning ready-to-go stance conveys eagerness, one boot placed ahead naturally.
Costume: practical short ivory travel jacket with celestial-blue panels, restrained gold piping and rolled cuffs, blue high-collar inner shirt, tailored dark-blue trousers, medium-height ivory-and-blue leather boots, light forearm bracers and a narrow belt. Small sky-blue half-cape over one shoulder with the same gold feather-shaped clasp as his sister. Keep the design simple enough to read as a playable character.
Wings: one pair of short rounded white feather wings held partly open, compact and springy silhouette compared with the sister's long tapered wings.
Weapon: elegant ivory-and-gold hand/forearm gauntlets, each generating one small clear luminous blue-gold ring of light suspended just beyond the hand. One hand open toward the viewer and the other lightly ready at his side, hands anatomically natural, not both fists covering the torso. Two rings only, modest size, do not hide his face or body, no staff or spear.
Personality: sincerely believes everyone has some goodness and that conversation can reach them, friendly, quick to offer help, a little careless. Lively male hero with no aggression or cynical grin. Predominant ivory and sky blue with restrained gold. Soft golden rim light and airy clean painterly rendering.
